40006754.author: पदार्थः
40006754.content: रामः Rama, अग्रतः in front, प्रययौ walked, सुमध्यमा a lady with a beautiful waist, सीता Sita, मध्ये in the middle, धनुष्पाणिः one holding the bow, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, पृष्ठतः following behind them, अनुजगाम ह followed.

40006754.author: Translation
40006754.content: Rama walked in front, Sita with a beautiful waist, in the middle and Lakshmana holding the bow, behind them৷৷

40006755.author: पदार्थः
40006755.content: तौ both (Rama and Lakshmana), विविधान् different, शैलप्रस्थान् chains of hills वनानि च and forests too, विविधाः different, रम्याः delightful, नदीश्च rivers, पश्यमानौ  seeing, सीतया सह along with Sita, जग्मतुः went.

40006755.author: Translation
40006755.content: Both Rama and Lakshmana walked on, accompanied by Sita, watching several beautiful mountain ranges, forests  and rivers.

40006756.author: पदार्थः
40006756.content: नदीपुलिनचारिणः roaming the riverbanks, सारसान् swans, चक्रवाकांश्च ruddy geese, सपद्मानि full of lotuses, जलजैः along with aquatic birds in the sky, खगैः with birds, युक्तानि joined with, सरांसि च lakes also.

40006756.author: Translation
40006756.content: (Watching) the swans and ruddy geese on river banks and lakes full of lotuses, and birds on water and in the sky.

40006757.author: पदार्थः
40006757.content: यूथबद्धान् in herds, पृषतान् deer, मदोन्मत्तान् intoxicated, विषाणिनः horned animals, महिषांश्च buffaloes, वराहांश्च wild boars, द्रुमवैरिणः enemies of trees, नागांश्च elephants also.

40006757.author: Translation
40006757.content: (Watching) herds of deer, intoxicated horned buffaloes, wild boars and elephants who are enemies of trees (elephants uproof trees).

40006758.author: पदार्थः
40006758.content: सहिताः together with, ते they, दूरम् distant, अध्वानाम् path, गत्वा having gone, दिवाकरे Sun, लम्बमाने was setting, पद्मपुष्करसम्बाधम् filled with lotuses, गजयूथैः with herds of elephants, अलङ्कृतम् adorned, जलचारिभिः with aquatic animals, सारसैः by cranes, हंस कादम्बैः with flocks of swans, सङ्कुलम् filled with, योजनायतम् spread over a yojana, रम्यम् delightful, तटाकम् tank, ददृशुः saw.

40006758.author: Translation
40006758.content: As the Sun was setting, they had covered a long distance, watching a yojanalong tank adorned with lotuses, and crowded with herds of elephants and flocks of cranes, swans and aquatic animals.

40006759.author: पदार्थः
40006759.content: सहिताः together with, ते they, दूरम् distant, अध्वानाम् path, गत्वा having gone, दिवाकरे Sun, लम्बमाने was setting, पद्मपुष्करसम्बाधम् filled with lotuses, गजयूथैः with herds of elephants, अलङ्कृतम् adorned, जलचारिभिः with aquatic animals, सारसैः by cranes, हंस कादम्बैः with flocks of swans, सङ्कुलम् filled with, योजनायतम् spread over a yojana, रम्यम् delightful, तटाकम् tank, ददृशुः saw.

40006759.author: Translation
40006759.content: As the Sun was setting, they had covered a long distance, watching a yojanalong tank adorned with lotuses, and crowded with herds of elephants and flocks of cranes, swans and aquatic animals.

40006760.author: पदार्थः
40006760.content: प्रसन्नसलिले in the clear water, रम्ये in a delightful place, तस्मिन् in that, सरसि lake, गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषः sounds of songs and musical instruments, शुश्रुवे heard, तु but, कश्चन none, न दृश्यते could be seen.

40006760.author: Translation
40006760.content: In that lake of clear waters they heard the sounds of songs and musical instruments, while there were none around.

40006761.author: पदार्थः
40006761.content: ततः thereafter, रामः Rama, महाबलः of great prowess, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana also, कौतूहलात् out of curiosity, धर्मभृतं नाम Dharmabrata by name, मुनिम् to a sage, प्रष्टुम् to enquire, समुपचक्रमे started.

40006761.author: Translation
40006761.content: Out of curiosity, mighty Rama, and Lakshmana started enquiring about the matter from sage Dharmabrata by name:

40006762.author: पदार्थः
40006762.content: महामुने O great sage, अत्यद्भुतम् very wonderful, इदम् this, श्रुत्वा after hearing, सर्वेषाम् for all, नः us, महत् great, कौतूहलम् curiosity, जातम् created, इदम् this, किम् what is this, साधु well, कथ्यताम् please tell us, प्रभो O lord, विप्र O sage, नातिगुह्यमपि यदि चेत् if there is no great secret about this, वक्तव्यम् let it be revealed.

40006762.author: Translation
40006762.content: O great sage, this very wonderful sound, has whetted our great curiosity. If there is no top secret about this, do disclose it.

40006763.author: पदार्थः
40006763.content: तदा then, तेन by that, राघवेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तः addressed, धर्मात्मा righteous one, मुनिः sage, सरसः of the lake, कृत्स्नम् entire, प्रभवम् origin, अख्यातुम् to narrate, उपचक्रमे started.

40006763.author: Translation
40006763.content: Thus addressed by Rama, the righteous sage narrated the entire origin of the lake.

40006764.author: पदार्थः
40006764.content: राम O Rama, इदम् this, माण्डकर्णिना by Mandakarni, मुनिना by sage, तपसा through penance, निर्मितम् is created, सार्वकालिकम् for all times (to be filled with water), पञ्चाप्सरः नाम by name Panchapsara, तटाकम् lake.

40006764.author: Translation
40006764.content: O Rama this lake called Panchapsara  filled with water at all times has been created through penance by a sage called Mandakarni.

40006765.author: पदार्थः
40006765.content: महामुनिः the great sage, सः that, माण्डकर्णि: Mandakarni, वायुभक्षः living on air, जलाश्रयः standing in water, दशवर्षसहस्राणि for ten thousand years, तीव्रम् intense, तपः penance, तेपे performed.

40006765.author: Translation
40006765.content: Great sage Mandakarni standing in water and living on air performed  rigorous penance for ten thousand years.

40006766.author: पदार्थः
40006766.content: ततः thereafter, साग्निपुरोगमाः with fire god in the forefront, सर्वे all, देवाः deities, प्रव्यथिताः very much perplexed, सर्वे all, परस्परसमागताः getting together at one place, वचनम् words, अब्रुवन् spoke to one another

40006766.author: Translation
40006766.content: Thereafter very much perturbed, all the gods led by Agni gathered together at one place and started deliberating among themselves.

40006767.author: पदार्थः
40006767.content: एषः this, मुनिः sage, अस्माकम् our, कस्यचित् of some one, स्थानम् place, प्रार्थयते he is praying for, इति like this, सर्वे all, ते of them, त्रिदिवौकसः gods whose abode is heaven, संविग्नमनसः  with agitated  minds.

40006767.author: Translation
40006767.content: 'The gods of heaven became agitated in their minds thinking the sage might usurp one of their places.

40006768.author: पदार्थः
40006768.content: सर्वैः by all, देवैः by gods, तत्र there, तपोविघ्नम् to disturb the penance, कर्तुम् to do, विद्युच्चलितवर्चसः glittering like lightning, पञ्च five, प्रधानाप्सरसः important nymphs नियोजिताः  engaged,

40006768.author: Translation
40006768.content: All the gods then engaged five of the important nymphs, glittering like lightning, to disturb the penance of the sage.

40006769.author: पदार्थः
40006769.content: ततः then, दृष्टपरावरः knower of the inner self and the world of plurality, मुनिः sage, ताभिः all of them, अप्सरोभिः by the apsaras, सुराणाम् of gods, कार्यसिद्धये for the achievement of their target, मदनवश्यत्वम् into the grip of Cupid, नीतः was taken.

40006769.author: Translation
40006769.content: The sage, a knower of the inner self and the world of plurality, was gripped by passion for the apsaras, who had come to achieve the target of the gods.

40006770.author: पदार्थः
40006770.content: ता: those, पञ्च five, अप्सरसः apsaras, मुनेः sage's, पत्नीत्वम् wifehood, आगताः became, तासाम् for them, गृहम् a home, अस्मिन् in that, तटाके lake, अन्तर्हितम् in invisible manner, निर्मितम् built.

40006770.author: Translation
40006770.content: The five apsaras, got the status of wives to the sage who built them an invisible home inside the lake.

40006771.author: पदार्थः
40006771.content: तथैव like that, अप्सरसः the apsaras, यथासुखम् happily निवसन्त्य: while living there, तपोयोगात् by the power of penance, यौवनम् youth, आस्थितम् attaining, मुनिम् sage, रमयन्ति are entertaining.

40006771.author: Translation
40006771.content: The apsaras lived happily with the sage who remained youthful by virtue of his penance.

40006772.author: पदार्थः
40006772.content: सङ्क्रीडमानानाम् while playing तासाम् for them, एषः this, वादित्रनिस्स्वनः the sound of musical instruments, भूषणोन्मिश्रः mingled with that of ornaments, मनोहरः pleasing to the ears, गीतशब्दः sound of songs, श्रूयते is heard.

40006772.author: Translation
40006772.content: While the apsaras played their musical instruments, their melodious songs mingled with the sounds of ornaments are heard.

40006773.author: पदार्थः
40006773.content: महायशाः glorious, राघवः Rama, सह भ्रात्रा with his brother, भावितात्मनः of selfrealised individuals तस्य his, एतत् this, वचनम् word, आश्चर्यमिति as wonderful, प्रतिजग्राह received.

40006773.author: Translation
40006773.content: Glorious Rama and his brother heard the wonderful words of the selfrealised sage and exclaimed, 'How strange '

40006774.author: पदार्थः
40006774.content: एवम् thus, कथयमानस्य narrating, कुशचीरसमाक्षिप्तम् one with kusa grass and bark garments, ब्राह्म्या of brahmin, लक्ष्म्यया with grace, समावृतम् spread all over, आश्रममण्डलम् hermitage, ददर्श saw.

40006774.author: Translation
40006774.content: When the sage Dharmabrata was telling the story, Rama saw a hermitage strewn all over with kusa grass and bark garments, and endowed with pure brahminic grace.

40006775.author: पदार्थः
40006775.content: महायशाः renowned, राघवः Rama, वैदेह्या सह accompanied by Vaidehi, लक्ष्मणेन च and also with Lakshmana, प्रविश्य entered, सर्वैः by all, मुनिभिः by sages too, पूज्यमानः were honoured, उवास dwelt.

40006775.author: Translation
40006775.content: Illustrious Rama accompanied by Vaidehi and Lakshmana entered the hermitage and, honoured by all the sages, stayed there.

40006776.author: पदार्थः
40006776.content: सः काकुत्थ्सः the scion of the Kakutstha race, तदा then, श्रीमति prosperous तस्मिन् in that, आश्रममण्डले in the hermitage complex, सुखम् comfortably, उषित्वा after living, तत्र there, पूज्यमानः being honoured by the sages, महास्त्रवित् wielder of great weapons, सः he, पूर्वम् earlier, येषाम् whose, सकाशे in the presence, उषितवान् he had resided, तेषाम् their, तपस्विनाम् sages', आश्रमान् hermitages, पर्यायेण in turn, जगाम went round.

40006776.author: Translation
40006776.content: Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha race, wielder of great weapons, stayed in that beautiful hermitage, accepting the hospitality of the sages extended with due honour, He visited in turn their penancegroves where he repeated his stay.

40006777.author: पदार्थः
40006777.content: सः काकुत्थ्सः the scion of the Kakutstha race, तदा then, श्रीमति prosperous तस्मिन् in that, आश्रममण्डले in the hermitage complex, सुखम् comfortably, उषित्वा after living, तत्र there, पूज्यमानः being honoured by the sages, महास्त्रवित् wielder of great weapons, सः he, पूर्वम् earlier, येषाम् whose, सकाशे in the presence, उषितवान् he had resided, तेषाम् their, तपस्विनाम् sages', आश्रमान् hermitages, पर्यायेण in turn, जगाम went round.

40006777.author: Translation
40006777.content: Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha race, wielder of great weapons, stayed in that beautiful hermitage, accepting the hospitality of the sages extended with due honour, He visited in turn their penancegroves where he repeated his stay.

40006778.author: पदार्थः
40006778.content: राघवः Rama, क्वचित् at one place, परिदशान् about ten, मासान् months, क्वचित् at another hermitage, एकम् one only, संवत्सरम् year, क्वचित् at one place, चतुरः four, मासान् months, क्वचित् at one hermitage, पञ्च five, षट् च six, अपरान् other months, अपरत्र and in another hermitage, मासादपि more than a month, अधिकम् more, क्वचित् at one place, अर्धम् half a month, अधिकम् more, त्रीन् three, मासान् months, अष्टमासान् for eight months, सुखम् comfortably, न्यवसत् dwelt.

40006778.author: Translation
40006778.content: Rama lived happily here for about ten months, there one year, here four or five or six months and there over one or half a month or three or eight months in another.

40006779.author: पदार्थः
40006779.content: राघवः Rama, क्वचित् at one place, परिदशान् about ten, मासान् months, क्वचित् at another hermitage, एकम् one only, संवत्सरम् year, क्वचित् at one place, चतुरः four, मासान् months, क्वचित् at one hermitage, पञ्च five, षट् च six, अपरान् other months, अपरत्र and in another hermitage, मासादपि more than a month, अधिकम् more, क्वचित् at one place, अर्धम् half a month, अधिकम् more, त्रीन् three, मासान् months, अष्टमासान् for eight months, सुखम् comfortably, न्यवसत् dwelt.

40006779.author: Translation
40006779.content: Rama lived happily here for about ten months, there one year, here four or five or six months and there over one or half a month or three or eight months in another.

40006780.author: पदार्थः
40006780.content: तथा in that way, तस्य for him, आश्रमेषु in the hermitages, वसतः while he was living, रमतश्च and enjoying, दश ten, संवत्सराः years, आनुकूल्येन favourably, ययुः passed.

40006780.author: Translation
40006780.content: Thus enjoying their stay in the hermitages, Rama, Sita and Lakshmana spent ten favourable years.

40006781.author: पदार्थः
40006781.content: धर्मज्ञः knower of dharma, श्रीमान् graceful, राघवः Rama, सीतया सह with Sita, परिवृत्य after going round, पुनरेव once again, सुतीक्ष्णस्य Sutikshna's, आश्रमम् hermitage, आजगाम ह returned.

40006781.author: Translation
40006781.content: Rama went round who was full of grace and full of knowledge on dharma went round with Sita and came back to Suthikshna's hermitage.

40006782.author: पदार्थः
40006782.content: अरिन्दमः subduer of enemies, सः रामः that Rama, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, आसाद्य on reaching, मुनिभिः by sages, प्रतिपूजितः being honoured, तत्रापि there again, कञ्चित्कालम् for some time, न्यवसत् he resided.

40006782.author: Translation
40006782.content: On his arrival, Rama, the subduer of enemies, was honoured by the sages at the hermitage where he stayed for a short time.

40006783.author: पदार्थः
40006783.content: तत् that, आश्रमस्थः staying in the hermitage, काकुत्स्थ: Rama, कदाचित् at one time, महामुनिम् to the great sage, सुतीक्ष्णम् Sutikshna, उपासीनः seated near, विनयात् out of humility, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40006783.author: Translation
40006783.content: Once while sitting beside sage Sutikshna at the hermitage Rama humbly addressed him:

40006784.author: पदार्थः
40006784.content: भगवान् Lord, मुनिसत्तमः best among the sages, अगस्त्यः Agastha, अस्मिन् in this, अरण्ये  in the forest, वसतीति is living, नित्यम् always, कथाः incidents, कथयताम् about that, श्रुतम् is heard.

40006784.author: Translation
40006784.content: I have heard others saying that lord Agastya, the great sage, lives in this forest.

40006785.author: पदार्थः
40006785.content: तु you, अस्य this, वनस्य forest, महत्तया due to its vastness, तं देशम् that place, न जानामि I do not know, धीमतः of the wise, तस्य महर्षेः of that sage, पुण्यम् sacred, अश्रमपदम् location of hermitage, कुत्र where.

40006785.author: Translation
40006785.content: I am unable to locate the sacred hermitage of that sagacious sage due to the vastness of this forest.

40006786.author: पदार्थः
40006786.content: भवतः your, प्रसादात् by grace, सानुजः with my brother, सह सीतया and along with Sita, मुनिम् sage, अगस्त्यम् Agastya, अभिवादयितुम् to offer our respectful salutations, तत्र there, अभिगच्छेयम् I wish to go.

40006786.author: Translation
40006786.content: By your grace, I wish to go there with Sita and my brother Lakshmana to offer our respectful salutations.

40006787.author: पदार्थः
40006787.content: तम् to that, मुनिवरम् best of sages, स्वयम् myself, अहम् I, शुश्रूषेयमपि I may serve, यदि that, एषः this, महान् great, मनोरथः desire, मे my, हृदि in the heart, परिवर्तते is being entertained.

40006787.author: Translation
40006787.content: There is a great desire  in my heart to serve in person the best of sages, Agastya.

40006788.author: पदार्थः
40006788.content: सः that, मुनिः sage, सुतीक्ष्णः Sutikshna, धर्मात्मनः of the righteous one, रामस्य of Rama, इति thus, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, प्रीतः pleased, दशरथात्मजम् to the son of Dasaratha, प्रत्युवाच replied.

40006788.author: Translation
40006788.content: Hearing the words of Rama, the righteous son of Dasaratha, sage Sutikshna was pleased to reply:

40006789.author: पदार्थः
40006789.content: राघव  O Rama, अहमपि I also, सलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, त्वाम् you, सीतया सह with Sita, अगस्त्यम् to Agastya, अभिगच्छ you may approach, इति thus, एतदेव that only, वक्तुकामः wished to tell.

40006789.author: Translation
40006789.content: I also wished you, O Raghava, to visit Agastya along with Sita and Lakshmana.

40006790.author: पदार्थः
40006790.content: दिष्ट्या luckily, इदानीम् presently, अस्मिन् in this, अर्थे connection, स्वयमेव yourself personally, माम् to me, ब्रवीषि you are speaking, वत्स dear son, महामुनिः the great sage, अगस्त्य: Agastya, यत्र where, अहम् I, ते to you, आख्यामि I will tell you.

40006790.author: Translation
40006790.content: Luckily you have asked me on your own. I will tell you where the great sage Agastya lives.

40006791.author: पदार्थः
40006791.content: तात dear child, आश्रमात् from this hermitage, चत्वारि योजनानि four yojanas, (8 x 4  32 miles) याहि you may go, ततः thereafter, दक्षिणेन in southern direction, अगस्त्यभ्रातुः Agastya of the brother of, महान् great, श्रीमान् beautiful, आश्रमः hermitage.

40006791.author: Translation
40006791.content: Dear Rama, walk from here a distance of four yojanas. There in the southerly direction  stands the great, beautiful hermitage of Agastya's brother.

40006792.author: पदार्थः
40006792.content: पिप्पलीवनशोभिते adorned with a fig forest, बहुपुष्पफले with many flowers and fruits, रम्ये in a beautiful, नानाशकुनिनादिते filled with delightful sounds of different birds, स्थलप्राये in mostly  plain land, वनोद्देशे in the forest region.

40006792.author: Translation
40006792.content: This plain land in the beautiful forest tract is adorned with fig trees,filled with  flowers, fruits, and delightful sounds of different birds.

40006793.author: पदार्थः
40006793.content: तत्र there, प्रसन्नसलिलाः clear water, शिवाः sacred, हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाः filled with swans and ducks, चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः beautiful with ruddy geese, विविधाः many, पद्मिन्यः lakes full of lotuses, राम O Rama, तत्र there, एकाम् one, रजनीम् night, व्युष्य after spending, प्रभाते early in the morning, गम्यताम् you can go.

40006793.author: Translation
40006793.content: O Rama, there are lotusponds filled with clear, sacred waters, with different kinds of swans, ducks and ruddy geese. Spend one night there and proceed early in the morning.

40006794.author: पदार्थः
40006794.content: तत्र there, प्रसन्नसलिलाः clear water, शिवाः sacred, हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाः filled with swans and ducks, चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः beautiful with ruddy geese, विविधाः many, पद्मिन्यः lakes full of lotuses, राम O Rama, तत्र there, एकाम् one, रजनीम् night, व्युष्य after spending, प्रभाते early in the morning, गम्यताम् you can go.

40006794.author: Translation
40006794.content: O Rama, there are lotusponds filled with clear, sacred waters, with different kinds of swans, ducks and ruddy geese. Spend one night there and proceed early in the morning.

40006795.author: पदार्थः
40006795.content: वनषण्डस्य of the cluster of trees, पार्श्वतः nearby, दक्षिणाम् in southerly, दिशम् direction, आस्थाय after setting out, योजनम् for a yojana, अन्तरा at a distance, गत्वा after going, तत्र there, अगस्त्याश्रमपदम् Agastya's hermitage.

40006795.author: Translation
40006795.content: If you go in the southern direction for a yojana you will find Agasthya's hermitage by the side of a cluster of trees.

40006796.author: पदार्थः
40006796.content: रमणीये enchanting, बहुपादपसङ्कुले full of many trees, तत्र there, वनोद्देशे in the forest tract, वैदेही Sita, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana too, त्वया सह along with you, रंस्यते will enjoy, बहुपादपसङ्कुलः filled with many trees, सः that, वनोद्देशः forest region, रम्यः delightful, हि will be.

40006796.author: Translation
40006796.content: Vaidehi will feel happy in your company in that delightful forest region full of many trees.So too will Lakshmana.

40006797.author: पदार्थः
40006797.content: महायशः O glorious one, महामुनिम् to the great sage, तम् him, अगस्त्यम् to Agastya, द्रष्टुम् to see, बुद्धि: mind, कृता यदि if arises, अद्यैव today itself, गमने in going, बुद्धिम् thought, रोचयस्व  may entertain.

40006797.author: Translation
40006797.content: O glorious one, if you have made up your mind to visit that great sage Agastya, think of starting today itself.

40006798.author: पदार्थः
40006798.content: रामः Rama, मुनेः sage's, इति this, श्रुत्वा having heard, भ्रात्रा सह  with brother, अभिवाद्य च reverentially saluted, सानुजः with his brother, सीतया सह with Sita, अगस्त्यम् Agastya, उद्दिश्य intending to move in that direction, प्रतस्थे moved out.

40006798.author: Translation
40006798.content: Rama heard the words of the sage, offered him reverential salutations and set out along with his brother and Sita.

40006799.author: पदार्थः
40006799.content: रम्याणि delightful, वनानि forests, अभ्रसन्निभान् looking like clouds, पर्वतांश्च mountains also, सरांसि lakes, पथि on his way, मार्गवशानुगाः moved in that direction, सरितश्च rivers also, पश्यन् while seeing, सुतीक्ष्णेन by Sutikshna, उपदिष्टेन as indicated, तेन पथा by that path, सुखम् happily, गत्वा after going, परमसंहृष्टः a very happy man, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इदम् this, वाक्यम् word, अब्रवीत् said.

40006799.author: Translation
40006799.content: Enjoying the sight of delightful forests, cloudlike mountains, lakes and rivers on the  way, and following the directions given by  Sutikshna, Rama was happy. He said  to Lakshmana:

40006800.author: पदार्थः
40006800.content: रम्याणि delightful, वनानि forests, अभ्रसन्निभान् looking like clouds, पर्वतांश्च mountains also, सरांसि lakes, पथि on his way, मार्गवशानुगाः moved in that direction, सरितश्च rivers also, पश्यन् while seeing, सुतीक्ष्णेन by Sutikshna, उपदिष्टेन as indicated, तेन पथा by that path, सुखम् happily, गत्वा after going, परमसंहृष्टः a very happy man, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इदम् this, वाक्यम् word, अब्रवीत् said.

40006800.author: Translation
40006800.content: Enjoying the sight of delightful forests, cloudlike mountains, lakes and rivers on the  way, and following the directions given by  Sutikshna, Rama was happy. He said  to Lakshmana:

40006801.author: पदार्थः
40006801.content: एतदेव this alone is, महात्मनः of the great one, पुण्यकर्मणः of holy deeds, अगस्त्यस्य मुनेः Sage Agastya's, भ्रातुः brother's, तस्य his, आश्रमपदम् hermitage, दृश्यते is seen, नूनम् surely.

40006801.author: Translation
40006801.content: Surely this is the hermitage of great Agastya's brother, a man of holy deeds.

40006802.author: पदार्थः
40006802.content: पथि on the path, फलभारेण with abundance of fruits, पुष्पभारेण च heavy with flowers, संन्नताः drooping down, सहस्रशः in thousands, अस्य वनस्य of this forest, द्रुमाः trees, यथा हि like that, मे I, ज्ञाताः were informed.

40006802.author: Translation
40006802.content: This is the glade we were told about with thousands of trees drooping down with abundant fruits and flowers.

40006803.author: पदार्थः
40006803.content: सहसा suddenly, पवनोक्षिप्तः wafted by the breeze, कटुकोदयः astringent aroma, पक्वानाम् of the  ripe fruits, पिप्पलीनाम् fig trees, अयं गन्धः this smell, अस्मात् from this, वनात् from the forest, उपागतः coming from.

40006803.author: Translation
40006803.content: Feel this sudden astringent smell of ripe figs wafted by the breeze from the forest.

40006804.author: पदार्थः
40006804.content: तत्र तत्र here and there, सङ्क्षिप्ताः collected, काष्ठसञ्चयाः heaps of firewood, दृश्यन्ते are seen, लूनाः cut, वैडूर्यवर्चसः shining like vaidurya (gems), दर्भाश्च blades of grass (used for sacrifices), पथि दृश्यन्ते are seen on the path.

40006804.author: Translation
40006804.content: Heaps of firewood are seen here and there on the path. There are blades of grass (used for sacrificial ceremonies) shining like vaidurya (gems).

40006805.author: पदार्थः
40006805.content: आश्रमस्थस्य on the hermitages, पावकस्य of the fire, कृष्णाभ्रशिखरोपमम् looking like the tip of the dark cloud, वनमध्यस्थम् appearing in the middle of the forest, एतत् this way, धूमाग्रम् smoke, सम्प्रदृश्यते are seen.

40006805.author: Translation
40006805.content: In the middle of the forest can be seen like the tip of the dark clouds columns of smoke coming out of the top of hermitages.

40006806.author: पदार्थः
40006806.content: विविक्तेषु in solitary places, तीर्थेषु in sacred spots, कृतस्नानाः after taking their bath, द्विजातयः brahmins, स्वयम् by themselves, अर्जितैः collected ones, कुसुमैः flowers, पुष्पोपहारम् offering of flowers, कुर्वन्ति doing.

40006806.author: Translation
40006806.content: Priests are coming out of the solitary sacred spots after their bath and making offerings of flowers they had themselves plucked.

40006807.author: पदार्थः
40006807.content: सौम्य O handsome one, तत् then, सुतीक्ष्णस्य Sutikshna's, वचनम् word, मया by me, यथा as, श्रुतम् was heard, एषः this, नूनम् surely, अगस्त्यस्य Agastya's, भ्रातुः brother's, आश्रमः hermitage, भविष्यति it will be.

40006807.author: Translation
40006807.content: O handsome one, surely this is the hermitage of Agastya's brother about which I heard from Sutikshna.

40006808.author: पदार्थः
40006808.content: यस्य whose, भ्रात्रा by the brother, पुण्यकर्मणा of holy deeds, लोकानाम् for the people, हितकाम्यया desirous of their welfare, तपसा with penance, मृत्युम् death, निगृह्य after controlling, इयम् this, दिक् direction, शरण्या worthy of refuge, कृता is rendered.

40006808.author: Translation
40006808.content: It was by whose holy brother, desiring the welfare of all people, that death was subdued through penance and this southern region was rendered worthy of refuge.

40006809.author: पदार्थः
40006809.content: इल्वलः Ilvala, ब्राह्मणम् a brahmin's, रूपम् form, धारायन् taking, संस्कृतम् Sanskrit, वदन् while speaking, निर्घृणः a cruel one, श्राद्धमुद्दिश्य for offering oblations to the dead on the day of anniversary, विप्रान् brahmins, आमन्त्रयति स्म invited.

40006809.author: Translation
40006809.content: Assuming the form of a brahmin and using Sanskrit language, Ilvala would invite brahmins for offering shraddha to the dead

40006810.author: पदार्थः
40006810.content: ततः thereafter, मेषरूपिणम् assuming the form of a sheep, तं भ्रातरम् his brother, संस्कृतम्   sanctified कृत्वा making, ततः then, श्राद्धदृष्टेन suitable for offering oblations to the dead, कर्मणा did, तान् द्विजान् those brahmins, भोजयामास offered them food.

40006810.author: Translation
40006810.content: Ilvala would keep his brother sanctified, so that he is fit for offering, Then he would feed the brahmins with mutton according to the rituals.

40006811.author: पदार्थः
40006811.content: ततः thereafter, मेषरूपिणम् assuming the form of a sheep, तं भ्रातरम् his brother, संस्कृतम्   sanctified कृत्वा making, ततः then, श्राद्धदृष्टेन suitable for offering oblations to the dead, कर्मणा did, तान् द्विजान् those brahmins, भोजयामास offered them food.

40006811.author: Translation
40006811.content: Ilvala would keep his brother sanctified, so that he is fit for offering, Then he would feed the brahmins with mutton according to the rituals.

40006812.author: पदार्थः
40006812.content: ततः then, तेषां विप्राणाम् when those brahmins, भुक्तवताम् finished eating, इल्वलः Ilvala, महता with a loud, स्वरेण voice, वदन् while shouting, वातापे O Vatapi, निष्क्रमस्व come out, इति thus, अब्रवीत् he spoke.

40006812.author: Translation
40006812.content: Then when the brahmins finished eating, Ilvala would call aloud, 'O Vatapi come out'.

40006813.author: पदार्थः
40006813.content: ततः then, वातापिः Vatapi, भ्रातुः brother's, वचः voice, श्रुत्वा on hearing, मेषवत् like a sheep, नदन् while bleating, ब्राह्मणानाम् of brahmins, शरीराणि from the bodies, भित्त्वा भित्त्वा tearing out one by one, विनिष्पतत् came out.

40006813.author: Translation
40006813.content: Then hearing his brother's voice, Vatapi would bleat like a sheep and jump out, tearing open the bodies of those brahmins.

40006814.author: पदार्थः
40006814.content: परन्तप O subduer of enemies, ताभ्याम् by both, संहत्य after killing, पिशिताशनैः by those carnivorous, ब्राह्मणानाम् brahmins, सहस्राणि in thousands, एवम् in that way, नित्यशः daily, विनाशितानि killed, तैः कामरूपिभिः by them assuming any form at will.

40006814.author: Translation
40006814.content: In this manner, thousands of brahmins used to be killed daily by those carnivorous demons who assumed any form at their free will.

40006815.author: पदार्थः
40006815.content: तदा then, देवैः by the gods, प्रार्थितेन on being requested, महर्षिणा by the ascetic, अगस्त्येन by Agastya, श्राद्धे in the shraddha, अनुभूय  experienced, सः महासुरः that mighty demon, भक्षितः was eaten, किल certainly.

40006815.author: Translation
40006815.content: Urged by the gods, Agastya  came  for the shradda . The mighty demon played the same routine trick and Vatapi, for sure, was eaten by the great sage.

40006816.author: पदार्थः
40006816.content: ततः then, सः इल्वलः that Ilvala, सम्पन्नम् the ritual is complete, इति like this, उक्त्वा  having said, दत्त्वा giving, निष्क्रमस्व you may come out, इति thus, भ्रातरम् brother, अभ्यभाषत said, ततः after offering, हस्तोदकं water in hand.

40006816.author: Translation
40006816.content: Saying, the ritual is complete Ilvala offered water in the palm of Agastya and called his brother to come out.

40006817.author: पदार्थः
40006817.content: धीमान् wise, मुनिसत्तमः best among the ascetics, अगस्त्यः Agastya, भ्रातरम् to brother, तथा स like that, भाषमाणम् while he spoke, विप्रघातिनम् destroyer of brahmins, तम् him, प्रहसन्  laughing aloud, अब्रवीत् said.

40006817.author: Translation
40006817.content: Wise Agastya,  the best among the ascetics, laughing aloud, said to Ilvala, the destroyer of brahmins:

40006818.author: पदार्थः
40006818.content: मया by me, जीर्णस्य digested, रक्षसः of the demon, मेषरूपस्य of the form of a sheep, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama (lord of death), गतस्य one who has gone, ते भ्रातुः your brother, निष्क्रमितुम् to come out, शक्तिः power, कुतः where from.

40006818.author: Translation
40006818.content: I have digested the demon Vatapi your brother, who assumed the form of a sheep. He has reached the abode of Yama, Lord of death. Where does he have the power to come out?

40006819.author: पदार्थः
40006819.content: अथ and then, भ्रातुः brothers, निधनसंश्रयम् pertaining to death, तस्य his, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, निशाचरः demon, क्रोधात् angrily, प्रधर्षयितुम् to attack, आरेभे started.

40006819.author: Translation
40006819.content: On hearing the news of the death of his brother, the demon Ilvala, out of anger, started attacking the sage.

40006820.author: पदार्थः
40006820.content: सः that (Ilvala), मुनिश्रेष्ठम् best among the sages, अभ्यद्रवत् pounced upon, दीप्ततेजसा by him whose lustre was kindled, मुनिना sage, अनलकल्पेन by firelike, चक्षुषा eyes, निर्दग्धः burnt, निधनं गतः died.

40006820.author: Translation
40006820.content: Ilvala who pounced upon Agastya, the best among the sages whose lustre lay consumed by the fire of his eyes which were in flames.

40006821.author: पदार्थः
40006821.content: तटाकवनशोभितः adorned with lakes and forests, अयम् this, येन by whom, विप्रानुकम्पया congenial to brahmins, इदम् this, दुष्करम् difficult, कर्म action, कृतम् is done, तस्य his, भ्रातुः brothers, आश्रम: hermitage.

40006821.author: Translation
40006821.content: This hermitage surrounded by beautiful lakes and forests belongs to his brother (Sudarsana). Out of sympathy for Agastya, he has accomplished this difficult task.

40006822.author: पदार्थः
40006822.content: तस्य रामस्य of Rama, सौमित्रिणा सह along with Lakshmana, एवम् in that way, कथयमानस्य     as he was narrating, सूर्यः Sun, अस्तं गतः had set, सन्ध्याकालः evening time, अभ्यवर्तत had set in.

40006822.author: Translation
40006822.content: While Rama was thus narrating to Lakshmana (the story of Agastya), the Sun set and evening closed in.

40006823.author: पदार्थः
40006823.content: सः that Rama, सह भ्रात्रा with his brother, यथाविधि as per rule, पश्चिमाम् western, सन्ध्याम् at twilight, उपास्य offered  oblations, आश्रमपदम् to the hermitage, विवेश entered, तम् that, ऋषिम् to the sage, अभ्यवादयत् greeted with folded palms.

40006823.author: Translation
40006823.content: Rama with his brother Lakshmana duly offered oblations at twilight, entered the hermitage and greeted the sage (Sudarsana) with folded palms.

40006824.author: पदार्थः
40006824.content: राघवः Rama, तेन मुनिना by that sage, सम्यक् properly, प्रतिगृहीतः was received, मूलफलानि roots and fruits, प्राश्य after eating, ताम् that, एकाम् one, निशाम् night, न्यवसत् spent.

40006824.author: Translation
40006824.content: Warmly received by the sage, Rama shared the roots and fruits and slept the night there.

40006825.author: पदार्थः
40006825.content: तस्यां रात्य्राम् when that night, व्यतीतायाम् was spent, सूर्यमण्डले when the Sun's orb, विमले was bright, राघवः Rama, अगस्त्यस्य Agasthya's, भ्रातरम् brother, तम् him, आमन्त्रयत bid him farewell.

40006825.author: Translation
40006825.content: When the night passed and the Sun became bright, Rama took leave of the brother of Agastya.

40006826.author: पदार्थः
40006826.content: भगवन् O lord , निशाम् night, सुखम् comfortably, अध्युषितः wellspent, त्वाम् you, अभिवादये I bow down, त्वाम् you, आमन्त्रये I seek your permission to leave, ते that, गुरुम्  respectable one, अग्रजम् elder brother, द्रष्टुम् to see, गच्छामि I will go.

40006826.author: Translation
40006826.content: O Lord, the night has been wellspent. Now we humbly seek leave of you to see your respectable elder brother.

40006827.author: पदार्थः
40006827.content: गम्यताम् you may go, इति like this तेन by him, उक्तः said, रघुनन्दनः Rama, the delight  of the Raghu dynasty, तत् that, वनम् forest, अवलोकयन् watching, यथोद्दिष्टेन in the indicated direction, मार्गेण path, जगाम went.

40006827.author: Translation
40006827.content: With his permission, Rama, the delight of the Raghu race, proceeded along the path indicated, watching (the beauty of) the forest.

40006828.author: पदार्थः
40006828.content: नीवारान् unvcultivated ricefields, पनसान् jackfruit trees, तालान् palmyra trees, तिमिशान् timishas, वञ्जुलान् ashoka, धवान् trees with white flowers, चिरिबिल्वान् trees existing for a long time, मधूकांश्च mahva trees, बिल्वानपि च and bilva trees, तिन्दुकान् tindukas.

40006828.author: Translation
40006828.content: They passed by wild rice fields, jackfruit trees, palmyra and various other trees like Ashoka, trees with white flowers, old trees that existed for a long time, mahva trees, bilva trees and tindukas.

40006829.author: पदार्थः
40006829.content: रामः Rama, हस्तिहस्तैः trunks of elephants, विमृदितान् crushed, वानरैः by monkeys, उपशोभितान् splendidlooking, मत्तै intoxicated, शतशः in hundreds, शकुनि सङ्गैश्च by flocks of birds, प्रणादितान् echoed, पुष्पितान् पुष्पिताग्राभिः flowers in bloom on top of trees, लताभिः by creepers, अनुवेष्टितान् surrounded by, शतशः hundreds, कान्तारपादपान् trees of the forest, ददर्श saw.

40006829.author: Translation
40006829.content: Rama saw hundreds of trees crushed by the trunks of elephants and by monkeys. He saw some trees echoing with notes of hundreds of intoxicated birds. He saw tree tops coiled with creepers in full bloom.

40006830.author: पदार्थः
40006830.content: रामः Rama, हस्तिहस्तैः trunks of elephants, विमृदितान् crushed, वानरैः by monkeys, उपशोभितान् splendidlooking, मत्तै intoxicated, शतशः in hundreds, शकुनि सङ्गैश्च by flocks of birds, प्रणादितान् echoed, पुष्पितान् पुष्पिताग्राभिः flowers in bloom on top of trees, लताभिः by creepers, अनुवेष्टितान् surrounded by, शतशः hundreds, कान्तारपादपान् trees of the forest, ददर्श saw.

40006830.author: Translation
40006830.content: Rama saw hundreds of trees crushed by the trunks of elephants and by monkeys. He saw some trees echoing with notes of hundreds of intoxicated birds. He saw tree tops coiled with creepers in full bloom.

40006831.author: पदार्थः
40006831.content: ततः then, राजीवलोचनः lotuseyed, रामः Rama, पृष्ठतः behind, अनुगतम् following, वीरम् chivalrous one, लक्ष्मिवर्धनम् one who enhances grace by his company, समीपस्थम् who stood nearby, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said.

40006831.author: Translation
40006831.content: Then the lotuseyed Rama said to the chivalrous, graceful Lakshmana who stood behind him:

40006832.author: पदार्थः
40006832.content: वृक्ष्याः trees, यथा here, स्निग्धपत्राः having glossy leaves, मृगद्विजाः animals and birds, यथा as, क्षान्ताः peaceful, भावितात्मनः of the selfrealised one.  महर्षेः of the great sage, आश्रमः hermitage, नातिदूरस्थः not very far.

40006832.author: Translation
40006832.content: The leaves of the trees here are glossy, the animals and birds are peaceful. It appears the hermitage of the selfrealized great sage Agastya is not very far from here.

40006833.author: पदार्थः
40006833.content: स्वेन by his, कर्मणा by deeds, लोके among people, अगस्त्यः as Agastya, इति  thus, विख्यातः wellknown, तस्य his, परिश्रान्तश्रमापहः place of rest for those who are tired with hard work, आश्रमः hermitage, दृश्यते is seen.

40006833.author: Translation
40006833.content: Here is the hermitage of Agastya, wellknown in the world for his deeds a place of rest for those tired with hard work.

40006834.author: पदार्थः
40006834.content: प्राज्यधूमाकुलवनः forest enveloped with smoke rising from the sacrificial altar, चीरमालापरिष्कृत: lined with rows of bark robes, प्रशान्तमृगयूथश्च with herds of quiet animals, नानाशकुनिनादितः resounding with notes of different kinds of birds.

40006834.author: Translation
40006834.content: This forest is enveloped with the smoke rising from the sacrificial altar. There are rows of bark robes hanging. Herds of quiet animals lying and different kind of birds chirping around.

40006835.author: पदार्थः
40006835.content: यस्य by whose, प्रभावात् by his power, राक्षसैः by the demons, इयम् this, दक्षिणा दिक् southern side, त्रासात् out of fear, दृश्यते is seen, नोपभुज्यते cannot be enjoyed, तस्य that Agastya's, आश्रमपदम् hermitage, इदम् this is.

40006835.author: Translation
40006835.content: This is his hermitage. On account of his (Agastya's) impact the demons look south but cannot eat the hermits out of fear (for the sage).

40006836.author: पदार्थः
40006836.content: यदा प्रभृति since, पुण्यकर्मणा by a man of sacred deeds, इयं दिक् this direction, आक्रान्ता occupied, तदाप्रभृति from then on, रजनीचराः those who move about at night, the demons, निर्वैराः leaving enmity, प्रशान्ताः are quiet.

40006836.author: Translation
40006836.content: Since the time Agastya of sacred deeds occupied this direction the demons are quiet, leaving all enmity.

40006837.author: पदार्थः
40006837.content: प्रदक्षिणा very considerate place, इयम् दक्षिणा दिक् on the southern side, भगवतः of the Lord (Agastya's), नाम्ना by name, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, प्रथिता famous, क्रूरकर्मभिः by men of wicked deeds, दुर्धर्षा unassailable.

40006837.author: Translation
40006837.content: The southern side favourable to the people was famous by the name Agastya in the three worlds and stood unassailable to the demons.

40006838.author: पदार्थः
40006838.content: श्रीमान् beautiful, विनीतजनसेवितः served by humble people, अयम् this, भास्करस्य Sun's, मार्गम् path, निरोद्धम् to obstruct, निरतः was ever bent upon, अचलोत्तमः that great mountain, विन्ध्य Vindhya, यस्य whose, निदेशम् order, पालयन् obeying, न वर्धते does not grow, तस्य for him, लोके in this world, विश्रुतकर्मणः of a man of renowned deeds, दीर्घायुषः of long life, अगस्त्यस्य Agastya's, आश्रमः hermitage.

40006838.author: Translation
40006838.content: This is the hermitage of the longlived Agastya who is renowned for his deeds and is served by humble people. The great mountain Vindhya that was growing incessantly and obstructing the path of the Sun stopped growing any more in obedience to Agastya's words.

40006839.author: पदार्थः
40006839.content: श्रीमान् beautiful, विनीतजनसेवितः served by humble people, अयम् this, भास्करस्य Sun's, मार्गम् path, निरोद्धम् to obstruct, निरतः was ever bent upon, अचलोत्तमः that great mountain, विन्ध्य Vindhya, यस्य whose, निदेशम् order, पालयन् obeying, न वर्धते does not grow, तस्य for him, लोके in this world, विश्रुतकर्मणः of a man of renowned deeds, दीर्घायुषः of long life, अगस्त्यस्य Agastya's, आश्रमः hermitage.

40006839.author: Translation
40006839.content: This is the hermitage of the longlived Agastya who is renowned for his deeds and is served by humble people. The great mountain Vindhya that was growing incessantly and obstructing the path of the Sun stopped growing any more in obedience to Agastya's words.

40006840.author: पदार्थः
40006840.content: लोकार्चितः worshipped by the people, साधुः a pious man, एषः he, सताम् हिते in the wellbeing of the virtuous, नित्यरतः ever engaged, एषः such, अभिगतान् those who have come, अस्मान् to us, श्रेयसा with welfare, योजयिष्यति will unite.

40006840.author: Translation
40006840.content: We are going to join this sage honoured by the people of the world and ever engaged in the welfare of the virtuous. This augurs well for us.

40006841.author: पदार्थः
40006841.content: प्रभो O noble one, अहम् I, अत्र here, तम् him, महामुनिम् to the great ascetic, अगस्त्यम् to Agastya, आराधयिष्यामि I will worship, वनवासस्य while living in the forest, शेषम् rest of the period, सौम्य  O handsome, अहम् वत्स्यामि I will spend.

40006841.author: Translation
40006841.content: O noble, handsome Lakshmana, I will spend the rest of the exile in this forest in the worship of the great sage Agastya.

40006842.author: पदार्थः
40006842.content: सगन्धर्वाः with gandharvas, देवाः the gods, सिद्धाश्च siddhas, परमर्षयः great sages, अत्र here, नियताहारम् controlled diet, अगस्त्यम् to Agastya's, सततम् always, पर्युपासते keep serving.

40006842.author: Translation
40006842.content: The gods along with gandharvas, siddhas and great sages always serve Agastya, observing discipine in their food habits.

40006843.author: पदार्थः
40006843.content: मृषावादी a liar, क्रूरो वा or a cruel one, यदि वा or perhaps, शठः a deceitful person, नृशंसः a wicked person, कामवृत्तो वा or a lustful person, अत्र here, न जीवेत् will not live, एषः मुनिः this  sage, तथाविधः of such type.

40006843.author: Translation
40006843.content: This sage is such type that he (his spiritual power) will not allow a liar or a cruel man or a deceitful or lustful  or wicked person to thrive here.

40006844.author: पदार्थः
40006844.content: देवाश्च gods also, यक्षाश्च yakshas too, पतगैस्सह along with birds, नागाश्च nagas too, नियताहाराः of controlled diet, धर्मम् righteous path, आराधयिष्णवः those who practise, अत्र here, वसन्ति live.

40006844.author: Translation
40006844.content: Here gods, yakshas, nagas and birds live, following the righteous path and observing discipline in food habits.

40006845.author: पदार्थः
40006845.content: अत्र here, महात्मानः great souls, परमर्षयः great sages, अत्र here, सिद्धाः siddhas, त्यक्तदेहाः giving up their bodies, नवैः with new, देहैः bodies, सूर्यसन्निभैः shining like the Sungod, विमानैः aerochariot, स्वर्याताः went to heaven.

40006845.author: Translation
40006845.content: Here great souls like sages and siddhas gave up the ghost and with renewed bodies left for heaven on aerochariot resembling the Sun (in brightness).

40006846.author: पदार्थः
40006846.content: शुभैः by benevolent ones, भूतैः by beings, अत्र here, आराधिताः those who are worshipped, देवाः gods, यक्षत्वम् status of demigods, अमरत्वं च status of gods, विविधानि several kinds of, राज्यानि च kingdoms also, प्रयच्छन्ति will endow.

40006846.author: Translation
40006846.content: Worshipped by benevolent beings, the gods here bestow on them the status of demigods or of the immortals or several kinds of kingdoms.
